name: roverit
description: RoverIt — Workstation OS Hub : gestion technique de matériel, reconditionnement et supervision d'infrastructures.
author: Martial Zinsou

scripts.build: npm run build -w @roverit/shared && npm run build -w @roverit/server && npm run build -w @roverit/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @roverit/shared && npm run typecheck -w @roverit/server && npm run typecheck -w @roverit/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @roverit/shared && npm run test -w @roverit/server
